cc:Work.dc:description: Recreation of gait_velocity_torque_balance.png using its 144 displayed values. Raw front/hind torque-squared imbalance, PPO minus PPO-TRS [percentage points]. Values retain the source's one-decimal precision. Each cell is a mean of 100 parallel trials. No experiment recomputation. Updated robot names: Go2, X1-Opposed, X1-Aligned.
